title: CJP and YouTuber Dhruv Rathee to Join People's Tribunal in Bengaluru Against Voter Roll Revision
detail: Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) and YouTuber Dhruv Rathee are set to participate in a 'People's Tribunal' in Bengaluru against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter rolls. Separately, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi vowed the opposition protest movement will continue until Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resigns over the controversial voter roll revision.
